description: Life Events for Vespexer characters from the Drinax Wasteland. Rolled when a career Event roll results in 'Life Event'. Roll 1D.

1.title: New Contact
1.text: You are not without friends. Pick Rachando, Chieftain Galx, Sal Dancet or Prince Harrick as a Contact.

2.title: Family Affairs
2.text: Roll 1D. 1-2: Someone close to you gives birth, and the tribe cannot feed another mouth. Either the child dies, or you must leave your current career and strike out as a Drifter or Rogue. 3-4: Your tribe is struck by disease, and someone in your family dies. Gain their possessions as a bonus Benefit roll. 5-6: One of your kin is accused of a crime and exiled from the tribe. Gain him as a vengeful Enemy, should you ever meet him again.

3.title: Romantic Entanglement
3.text: The tribe must grow, and you are married off. Roll 1D to see how it turned out. 1-2: Partner died. 3-5: Ongoing relationship — gain your spouse as an Ally, and you have 1D-3 children. 6: Tragic death or disappearance.

4.title: Misfortune
4.text: You suffer an unfortunate accident. Roll 1D. 1-2: You are framed for a crime and exiled from the tribe. Gain your persecutor as an Enemy and reduce SOC by 1. 3-4: While exploring a ruined city, you contract a disease left over from the Aslan attack. Reduce END by 1. 5-6: You are wounded while hunting, and worse, your hazard suit is torn. Lose one Benefit roll to pay for its repair.

5.title: Good Fortune
5.text: Fortune smiles upon you. Roll 1D. 1-2: Rachando the merchant offers you a good price for a relic recovered from the ruined cities. Gain 1D×Cr10,000. 3-4: A travelling merchant or smuggler offers you a place on board his ship. You may automatically qualify for the Rogue or Merchant career. 5-6: Your tribe prospers. Gain an extra Benefit roll.

6.title: Unusual Event
6.text: Roll 1D. 1-2: You are psionic! Roll to test your Psionic Strength immediately, and gain DM+4 to the roll. 3-4: You find the wreckage of an Aslan ship that crashed on Drinax, and recover a mysterious chest from its cargo hold. You have never managed to open the chest, but it bears the symbol of the Syoisuis assassin-clan. 5-6: When you were a child, the tribe's wise-woman declared that you were the Hlax Kur Eisa — the messiah who would avenge the Vespexers upon the Aslan.
